title: Vulnerability digest — 25 Nov 2026, 18:44 CET
markdown:
- **CVE-2026-135224**, MongoDB C Driver: It fails to verify if the party signing a certificate revocation response is authorized, allowing an unauthenticated TLS endpoint operator to accept a withdrawn certificate and potentially disclose database traffic or lose revocation decisions. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135224), [Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/CDRIVER-6500)
- **CVE-2026-135147**, MongoDB PHP Driver: A data-query neutralization weakness in a PHP web framework's query builder allows bulk counter-update values to be interpreted as query expressions rather than plain text, potentially writing unintended values and disclosing stored document data. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135147), [Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PHPLARA-310)
- **CVE-2026-135144**, MongoDB PHP Driver: A query builder in a PHP web framework integration library skips registered query-modification callbacks before sending operations to the database, causing application access filters to be silently omitted and allowing basic users to read or change restricted records. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135144), [Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PHPLARA-321)
- **CVE-2026-135145**, MongoDB PHP Driver: A polymorphic relationship query helper resolves record type identifiers inconsistently between storage and search code, which can cause relationship-absence restrictions to fail and let basic users access or modify restricted records. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135145), [Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PHPLARA-320)
- **CVE-2026-135133**, MongoDB PHP Driver: Passing non-string values to specific string options or type-mapping settings causes an invalid memory release in the extension, which can lead to memory corruption, process crashes, or arbitrary command execution as the PHP user. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135133), [Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PHPC-2746)
- **CVE-2026-62154**, EnterpriseDB MySQL Foreign Data Wrapper (mysql_fdw): During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw improperly quotes column metadata from remote servers, allowing a compromised MySQL server or attacker to execute arbitrary SQL in the local PostgreSQL session; the issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0, which quotes these values. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-62154), [GitHub Release](https://github.com/EnterpriseDB/mysql_fdw/releases/tag/REL-2_10_0), [EnterpriseDB Advisory](https://www.enterprisedb.com/docs/security/advisories/cve202662154/)

items.title: The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is author…
items.match_text:
The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is authorized to answer for the certificate being checked. An unauthenticated party that operates the TLS endpoint a client connects to can therefore have a withdrawn certificate accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of the application's database traffic and in the loss of the revocation decision.
MongoDB C Driver

items.title: A data-query neutralization weakness in the query builder of the MongoDB integration for a PHP web framework allows valu…
items.match_text:
A data-query neutralization weakness in the query builder of the MongoDB integration for a PHP web framework allows values supplied to certain bulk counter-update helpers to be interpreted by the database as query expressions rather than stored as plain text. An application that passes externally supplied data into these helpers may write unintended values into stored documents and may result in unintended disclosure of other data held on the same document. No credentials are required of the party supplying the value.
MongoDB PHP Driver

items.title: A query builder component in a MongoDB integration library for a PHP web framework does not run the query-modification c…
items.match_text:
A query builder component in a MongoDB integration library for a PHP web framework does not run the query-modification callbacks that an application registers with the framework before sending read, update, and delete operations to the database. As a result, a filter that an application relies on to limit which records a request may touch can be omitted silently. A user with basic application privileges may be able to read or change records that the application intended to keep out of reach.
MongoDB PHP Driver

items.title: A polymorphic relationship query helper in the MongoDB Eloquent integration for Laravel resolves a record's type identif…
items.match_text:
A polymorphic relationship query helper in the MongoDB Eloquent integration for Laravel resolves a record's type identifier inconsistently between the code that stores a relationship link and the code that searches for one. An application that relies on a relationship-absence query to restrict which records a request may see or change can therefore have that restriction silently fail, allowing a user with basic application privileges to read and to modify or remove records the restriction was meant to cover.
MongoDB PHP Driver

items.title: An invalid memory release in the MongoDB PHP Driver extension occurs when certain string-typed options or type-mapping s…
items.match_text:
An invalid memory release in the MongoDB PHP Driver extension occurs when certain string-typed options or type-mapping settings are given non-string values. A party who can run PHP code in a process that loads the extension may corrupt process memory. This can lead to reading or changing process memory, running commands as the PHP process user, or crashing the process.
MongoDB PHP Driver

items.title: During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw copies column metadata returned by the remote MySQL server into the CREATE FOREI…
items.match_text:
During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw copies column metadata returned by the remote MySQL server into the CREATE FOREIGN TABLE statements it runs locally without quoting it. The COLUMN_DEFAULT value is placed directly in the DEFAULT clause, and the name of the generated ENUM type is inserted unquoted. A malicious or compromised MySQL server, or an attacker who can tamper with the connection, can return crafted information_schema metadata and run arbitrary SQL in the local PostgreSQL session of the user who runs IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw quotes these values before building the statements.
EnterpriseDB MySQL Foreign Data Wrapper (mysql_fdw)
